abolish.en: The city plans to abolish an outdated rule next year.
abolish.zh: 市政府計畫明年廢除一項過時規定。

abrupt.en: The abrupt change in temperature surprised the research team.
abrupt.zh: 溫度突然改變讓研究團隊感到意外。

absurd.en: The claim sounded absurd because it lacked any supporting evidence.
absurd.zh: 這項說法聽起來很荒謬，因為完全沒有證據支持。

abundant.en: The region has abundant rainfall during the summer months.
abundant.zh: 這個地區夏季有充沛的降雨。

accelerate.en: Better equipment can accelerate the process without reducing accuracy.
accelerate.zh: 更好的設備可以加快流程，同時不降低準確度。

accessible.en: The school library makes digital resources accessible to all students.
accessible.zh: 學校圖書館讓所有學生都能使用數位資源。

accommodate.en: The classroom can accommodate forty students during the workshop.
accommodate.zh: 這間教室在工作坊期間可以容納四十位學生。

accompany.en: A short explanation should accompany each chart in the report.
accompany.zh: 報告中的每張圖表都應附上一段簡短說明。

adjacent.en: The science lab is adjacent to the main classroom building.
adjacent.zh: 科學實驗室就在主要教學大樓旁邊。

administer.en: Teachers administer the survey at the end of each semester.
administer.zh: 老師會在每學期末進行這項問卷調查。

adverse.en: Heavy rain had an adverse effect on the outdoor experiment.
adverse.zh: 大雨對戶外實驗造成了不利影響。

aggregate.en: The report presents aggregate data from all participating classes.
aggregate.zh: 這份報告呈現所有參與班級的整體資料。

analogy.en: The teacher used an analogy to explain the difficult concept.
analogy.zh: 老師用類比來解釋這個困難概念。

anonymous.en: The survey remained anonymous so students could answer freely.
anonymous.zh: 這份問卷採匿名方式，讓學生可以自由作答。

apparatus.en: The laboratory apparatus must be checked before each experiment.
apparatus.zh: 每次實驗前都必須檢查實驗室器材。

assemble.en: Students assemble the model by following the illustrated instructions.
assemble.zh: 學生按照圖示說明組裝模型。

authentic.en: The museum displayed an authentic document from the early twentieth century.
authentic.zh: 博物館展示了一份二十世紀初的真實文件。

autonomous.en: The robot can perform several tasks in an autonomous mode.
autonomous.zh: 這台機器人可以在自主模式下完成數項任務。

boost.en: A short break can boost concentration during a long study session.
boost.zh: 長時間讀書時，短暫休息可以提升專注力。

catalyst.en: The new policy became a catalyst for wider environmental changes.
catalyst.zh: 這項新政策成為推動更廣泛環境改變的催化劑。

cautious.en: Researchers were cautious when interpreting the limited amount of data.
cautious.zh: 研究人員在解讀有限資料時非常謹慎。

chronic.en: The article discusses chronic traffic problems in large cities.
chronic.zh: 這篇文章討論大城市長期存在的交通問題。

cite.en: Students should cite reliable sources when writing research reports.
cite.zh: 學生撰寫研究報告時應引用可靠來源。

coincide.en: The two events happen to coincide on the same weekend.
coincide.zh: 這兩項活動剛好在同一個週末舉行。

collective.en: The final decision reflected the collective opinion of the whole group.
collective.zh: 最後決定反映了整個小組的共同意見。

commodity.en: Rice remains an important commodity in many parts of Asia.
commodity.zh: 稻米在亞洲許多地區仍是重要商品。

compensate.en: Extra practice can compensate for a lack of earlier experience.
compensate.zh: 額外練習可以彌補先前經驗不足。

competent.en: A competent team can complete the task efficiently and accurately.
competent.zh: 有能力的團隊可以有效率且準確地完成任務。

conceive.en: It is difficult to conceive a solution without enough information.
conceive.zh: 在資訊不足的情況下，很難構想出解決方案。

concurrent.en: The system can handle several concurrent requests without slowing down.
concurrent.zh: 這套系統可以同時處理多個請求而不變慢。

confidential.en: The school keeps personal student information confidential at all times.
confidential.zh: 學校始終將學生個人資料保密。

conform.en: All entries must conform to the format listed in the instructions.
conform.zh: 所有輸入內容都必須符合說明中的格式。

consensus.en: The group reached a consensus after discussing several possible solutions.
consensus.zh: 小組討論數個可能方案後達成共識。

conserve.en: Students were encouraged to conserve water during the dry season.
conserve.zh: 乾季期間，學生被鼓勵節約用水。

contaminate.en: Dirty tools can contaminate samples and affect the final results.
contaminate.zh: 髒污的工具可能污染樣本並影響最後結果。

conventional.en: The study compares a conventional method with a newer approach.
conventional.zh: 這項研究比較傳統方法與較新的做法。

cooperate.en: Students must cooperate closely to finish the project on time.
cooperate.zh: 學生必須密切合作，才能準時完成專題。

cumulative.en: The graph shows the cumulative total after each month of data collection.
cumulative.zh: 這張圖顯示每個月資料蒐集後的累積總量。

deteriorate.en: The condition of the equipment may deteriorate without regular maintenance.
deteriorate.zh: 若沒有定期保養，設備狀況可能會惡化。

devote.en: She plans to devote more time to reading before the exam.
devote.zh: 她打算在考前投入更多時間閱讀。

diagnose.en: Engineers used the test results to diagnose the system problem.
diagnose.zh: 工程師利用測試結果判斷系統問題。

discrete.en: The experiment divides the data into several discrete categories.
discrete.zh: 這項實驗把資料分成數個彼此獨立的類別。

disperse.en: Strong winds can disperse smoke across a wide area.
disperse.zh: 強風可以把煙霧吹散到廣大區域。

distort.en: Poor scaling can distort the meaning of a statistical graph.
distort.zh: 不當的比例可能扭曲統計圖表所傳達的意義。

ethical.en: Researchers must follow ethical rules when collecting personal information.
ethical.zh: 研究人員蒐集個人資訊時必須遵守倫理規範。

exploit.en: The design aims to exploit natural light during the daytime.
exploit.zh: 這項設計旨在白天充分利用自然光。

extract.en: Students extract key information from the passage before answering questions.
extract.zh: 學生回答問題前先從文章中擷取關鍵資訊。

fragile.en: The fragile instrument must be carried carefully between classrooms.
fragile.zh: 這項易碎儀器在教室間搬運時必須格外小心。

legitimate.en: The teacher asked whether the source was legitimate and trustworthy.
legitimate.zh: 老師要求確認這個來源是否合法且值得信任。

manipulate.en: Students manipulate the model to observe how each part moves.
manipulate.zh: 學生操作模型來觀察各個部件如何移動。

minimize.en: Careful planning can minimize errors during the final experiment.
minimize.zh: 仔細規劃可以把最後實驗中的錯誤降到最低。

mutual.en: Successful teamwork depends on mutual respect among all group members.
mutual.zh: 成功的團隊合作有賴所有成員彼此尊重。

prevail.en: Calm discussion should prevail when opinions strongly disagree.
prevail.zh: 當意見強烈分歧時，冷靜討論應該占上風。

prohibit.en: School rules prohibit students from entering the laboratory without permission.
prohibit.zh: 校規禁止學生未經許可進入實驗室。

prominent.en: The chart highlights a prominent increase in energy use during winter.
prominent.zh: 這張圖表顯示冬季能源使用量有明顯增加。

rational.en: A rational decision should be based on evidence and clear reasoning.
rational.zh: 合理的決定應建立在證據與清楚推理之上。

regulate.en: The device can regulate temperature automatically throughout the experiment.
regulate.zh: 這個裝置可以在整個實驗期間自動調節溫度。

restore.en: The team worked to restore the damaged file from a backup.
restore.zh: 團隊嘗試從備份中還原受損檔案。

scarce.en: Clean water becomes scarce in some regions during long droughts.
scarce.zh: 長期乾旱期間，有些地區的乾淨用水會變得稀缺。

spontaneous.en: A spontaneous discussion began after the class watched the short film.
spontaneous.zh: 全班看完短片後，自發展開了一場討論。

trigger.en: A sudden temperature change can trigger an automatic warning signal.
trigger.zh: 溫度突然改變可能觸發自動警示訊號。

undertake.en: The class will undertake a small research project this semester.
undertake.zh: 全班這學期將進行一項小型研究專題。

viable.en: The team selected the most viable solution after comparing costs.
viable.zh: 團隊比較成本後，選出最可行的解決方案。
